page.overview:
Who is Beaver Bros.?

The are anthropomorphic Animal characters in . Their names are not mentioned in-game despite the young one being called Shtick (the one carrying branches) and the older one Twig (with the lifebelt).

The swim around in the at the source of the river in the . They consider to be valuable items and will not give them up easily. tried to race them in order to obtain a from them, but ultimately failed. Thus, when Link first meets them as , they mistake him for the guitarist of .

In order to obtain their , Link will have to challenge the separately in a . First, the will challenge the young Hero of Time, and if he succeeds, he will call his to race against Link. This time, will have to go through even more rings in order to win against the , and upon completion, the two will begrudgingly reward Link with a .

Link can race again to win a from them, for they do not have any more . This time, the time limit is shortened for both , and if he succeeds, the will hand over a in hopes that he will finally leave them alone.
